mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, content_id AS contentId, LEAST(5.0, -- 评分上限为5分 ( -- 浏览权重35% + 收藏权重65% + 停留时间加成 total_views * 0.35 + total_collects * 0.65 + CASE WHEN total_duration < 6000 THEN 0.0 WHEN total_duration < 20000 THEN 0.5 WHEN total_duration < 60000 THEN 1.0 ELSE 1.5 END ) / GREATEST(1, (total_views + total_collects)) * 5.0 ) AS score FROM ( SELECT user_id, content_id, -- 浏览数（type=3） SUM(CASE WHEN type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_views, -- 收藏数（type=1） SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_collects, -- 总停留时间（type=4） SUM(CASE WHEN type = 4 THEN COALESCE(stay_time, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_duration, -- 总行为数 COUNT(*) AS total_actions FROM user_action_operation WHERE type IN (1, 3, 4) -- 只考虑收藏、浏览、停留行为 AND content_module = #{contentModule} AND content_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id, content_id HAVING total_views > 0 OR total_collects > 0 -- 至少有一次浏览或收藏 ) AS aggregated_data ORDER BY score DESC, total_actions DESC;

SELECT content_id, SUM( CASE type WHEN 1 THEN 5 -- 收藏，权重5 WHEN 2 THEN 3 -- 点赞，权重3 WHEN 3 THEN 1 -- 浏览，权重1 WHEN 4 THEN CASE WHEN stay_time IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN stay_time < 1000 THEN 1 -- 停留1秒以内 WHEN stay_time < 5000 THEN 2 -- 停留1-5秒 WHEN stay_time < 15000 THEN 3 -- 停留5-15秒 WHEN stay_time < 30000 THEN 4 -- 停留15-30秒 WHEN stay_time < 60000 THEN 5 -- 停留30-60秒 ELSE 6 -- 停留60秒以上 END ELSE 0 END ) AS hot_score FROM user_action_operation WHERE type IN (1, 2, 3, 4) AND content_module = #{contentModule} GROUP BY content_id ORDER BY hot_score DESC LIMIT #{current},#{size}
